result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both are focused intake forms with instrument-specific wording (type, make and model, serial or marks, case and accessories) and the same order: you, then the instrument, then the problem. A shows a little more of the problem section and offers instrument-specific checklists. B explains that nothing is sent anywhere and that either phone or email is required, but leaves a '[Shop name]' placeholder. Neither screenshot shows the confirmation, so item 3 can't be told apart and gets the same mid score for both. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both screenshots only show the top of the form, so I couldn't see either confirmation screen and scored item 3 cautiously for both. B fits more of the task into view: a 'Case or bow included?' choice and a 'What's wrong?' section that lists common problems for the chosen instrument, which suits a repair intake well. A uses good instrument wording and explains that nothing is sent anywhere, but its problem section isn't visible and it takes up more space before getting to what's wrong.
